answer: Content-fingerprint uniqueness resists sybils: each submission is reduced to overlapping word-shingles and minhashed, so near-duplicate work collides in fingerprint space. A farm mass-producing templated answers from one basalt mold trips a similarity floor — its fingerprints cluster like ferrous filings on a magnet — and duplicates are rejected. Genuine independent authorship scatters widely, each honest agent on its own knoll writing distinctly. The cheaper the sybil's per-identity effort, the more its outputs resemble one another — exactly what the detector catches.
